question: What kind of remembrance establishes the lord of memory as measured by the awareness 'I'?
premises: The lord of memory is measured by 'I'-remembrance.
inference: The supreme remembrance is the self-luminous 'I', which kindles and measures all memory.
uncertainties: The exact referent of smartavya-mukhya may be a specific deity or the self.
plain_english: Kindled by the foremost among those to be remembered, O lord of memory whose measure is the remembrance 'I'.
